name: Detroit Diesel 6V-71N [two-stroke V6 diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 6V-71N [two-stroke V6 diesel], 7.0 L (426 cu in): 4.25 x 5 in, 18.7:1, a
gear-driven 6-71 Roots blower, unit injectors, four exhaust valves per cylinder. 238 hp at
2100 rpm and about 630 lb-ft, governed at 2100, idling at 500.

blower.comment: The 6-71 blower: two three-lobe rotors, geared 1.95 times crank speed

name: Detroit Diesel 6V-71T [two-stroke V6 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 6V-71T [two-stroke V6 turbo diesel], 7.0 L: the 6V-71 with a turbo ahead of its
blower, 17:1. About 300 hp at 2100 rpm.

name: Detroit Diesel 8V-71N [two-stroke V8 diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 8V-71N [two-stroke V8 diesel], 9.3 L (568 cu in): 4.25 x 5 in, 18.7:1, an 8-71
Roots blower. 318 hp at 2100 rpm and about 850 lb-ft. Its four throws at right angles in a
63.5 deg V make it fire unevenly.

blower.comment: The 8-71 blower: two three-lobe rotors, geared 2.0 times crank speed

name: Detroit Diesel 8V-71TA [two-stroke V8 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 8V-71TA [two-stroke V8 turbo diesel], 9.3 L: a turbo ahead of the 8-71 blower
and an aftercooler behind it, 17:1. 435 hp at 2100 rpm.

blower.comment: A turbo into the 8-71 blower, then an aftercooler

name: Detroit Diesel 12V-71N [two-stroke V12 diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 12V-71N [two-stroke V12 diesel], 14.0 L (852 cu in): two 6V-71s end to end,
each with its 6-71 blower. 475 hp at 2100 rpm.

name: Detroit Diesel 12V-71T [two-stroke V12 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 12V-71T [two-stroke V12 turbo diesel], 14.0 L: two turbos ahead of its two 6-71
blowers, 17:1. About 525 hp at 2100 rpm.

name: Detroit Diesel 16V-71TI [two-stroke V16 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 16V-71TI [two-stroke V16 turbo diesel], 18.6 L (1136 cu in): two 8V-71s end to
end, two turbos ahead of two 8-71 blowers and an intercooler, 17:1. About 900 hp at 2300 rpm
(marine and industrial).

blower.comment: Two turbos into two 8-71 blowers, then the intercooler

name: Detroit Diesel 6V-92N [two-stroke V6 diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 6V-92N [two-stroke V6 diesel], 9.0 L (552 cu in): the 6V-71's block bored to
4.84 in, 19:1, a bigger blower. About 277 hp at 2100 rpm.

blower.comment: The 6V-92's blower: two three-lobe rotors, geared 2.0 times crank speed

name: Detroit Diesel 6V-92TA [two-stroke V6 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 6V-92TA [two-stroke V6 turbo diesel], 9.0 L: a turbo ahead of the blower and an
aftercooler, 17:1. 350 hp at 2100 rpm and about 1000 lb-ft at 1200.

blower.comment: A turbo into the blower, then the aftercooler

name: Detroit Diesel 8V-92N [two-stroke V8 diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 8V-92N [two-stroke V8 diesel], 12.1 L (736 cu in): 4.84 x 5 in, 19:1. About
368 hp at 2100 rpm. It fires unevenly, as the 8V-71 does.

blower.comment: The 8V-92's blower, geared 2.0 times crank speed

name: Detroit Diesel 8V-92TA [two-stroke V8 turbo diesel]
comment:
Detroit Diesel 8V-92TA [two-stroke V8 turbo diesel], 12.1 L: a turbo ahead of the blower and
an aftercooler, 17:1. 475 hp at 2100 rpm and about 1300 lb-ft at 1300.

blower.comment: A turbo into the blower, then the aftercooler

name: Detroit Diesel 16V-92TA [two-stroke V16 turbo diesel]

blower.comment: Two turbos into two blowers, then the aftercoolers
